metadata.title: AI RMF Baseline Profile (community example)

parties.name: ai-rmf-oscal-catalog community contributors
parties.remarks: Community contributors to the ai-rmf-oscal-catalog project. Not produced by, endorsed by, or affiliated with NIST.

metadata.remarks: A minimal OSCAL profile that imports the community AI RMF v0.3 catalog and selects all 72 subcategory controls. This profile is a worked example demonstrating how the catalog is consumed by downstream tooling, not an opinionated baseline for any particular sector, risk posture, or compliance regime. Downstream profiles deriving narrower selections (e.g., GOVERN-only, or skipping MEASURE 2.12 environmental impact in contexts where it is out of scope) should replace `include-all` with `include-controls` or add `exclude-controls`. Released under CC0 1.0.

resources.title: AI RMF community OSCAL catalog (v0.3)
resources.description: Resolves to the v0.3 catalog generated by src/generator.py from this repository. Two rlinks are provided: the canonical HTTPS URL on GitHub for production use, and a relative filesystem path for local validation runs.
resources.remarks: First rlink is preferred when validating from outside this repository. Second rlink works when validating from inside the repo (relative to profiles/).
